properties.name: app.instance-id
properties.description: Unique identifier for the current application instance, used to distinguish nodes when running multiple instances.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Semicolon-separated list of origins allowed to access the API through CORS.

properties.name: security.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and validate JWT tokens.

properties.name: security.cookie.secure
properties.description: Defines whether authentication cookies should only be sent over HTTPS connections.

properties.name: security.cookie.same-site
properties.description: SameSite policy applied to authentication cookies, controlling whether they are sent with cross-site requests.
